description: Cached authentication credentials are not protected from unauthorized access or extraction. This signal indicates that stored credentials may be vulnerable to theft through credential dumping attacks.
applicability: Applicable to systems that cache credentials. Includes Windows credential manager, browser password stores, SSH key storage, and application credential caches.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through credential storage configuration review, encryption verification, and credential protection mechanism assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
